world.name: World style
world.text: Art direction: Free Kick Classics, an original football game about a single dead-ball moment stretched into a dream. Stylized 3D with hand-painted textures, like a frame from a painterly animated film. Immersive, escapist and slightly surreal: the world around the pitch can bend, glow and dissolve, but the football always reads clearly, because the goal frame, the ball and the players carry the strongest contrast and the cleanest shapes. Soft volumetric light, low atmospheric haze, visible brushwork in skies and crowds, luminous accents. Graceful, slightly elongated character proportions with expressive faces. Cinematic composition with depth of field.

sheet.name: Model sheet style
sheet.text: This is a reference sheet for 3D modelling and animation in Blender. Stylized 3D look with hand-painted textures, matching the attached style reference. Orthographic views with no perspective distortion: every view at the same scale and standing on one shared ground line. Even, flat studio lighting with no cast shadows. Plain light grey background (#D8D8D8) with nothing else in frame. Do not draw numbers, arrows or labels.

texture.name: Texture style
texture.text: This is a texture for a 3D game. View it straight down, with perfectly flat, even lighting and no shadows or highlights. It must tile seamlessly on all four edges and fill the whole frame edge to edge. Hand-painted, stylized look that matches the attached style reference.

rules: Original design: not based on any real footballer, club, national team, stadium, brand or video game. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, sponsor marks or watermarks anywhere in the image.

sections.name: Start here
sections.blurb: The style keyframe sets the look for everything else. Make it first, pick the variation you love, and attach it to every later prompt.

sections.name: Characters
sections.blurb: Turnaround sheets I model and rig from. Keep each character in its own ChatGPT chat so the face and kit stay consistent.

sections.name: Animation poses
sections.blurb: Key-pose sheets I turn into keyframed animations. Attach the character's turnaround so the poses match the model.

sections.name: Ball, goal and pitch
sections.blurb: Props I model to real dimensions: a 22 cm ball, a 7.32 × 2.44 m goal, the 9.15 m spray line.

sections.name: Arena and cameras
sections.blurb: The first playable world and the camera framings the shootout uses on a phone.

sections.name: Moments
sections.blurb: Frames that direct the animation, lighting and effects at the beats that matter: the stare-down, the goal, the save.

sections.name: Textures
sections.blurb: Surfaces I map onto the models. Ask ChatGPT for a square image.

sections.name: Eras and Classics
sections.blurb: The other worlds: the two remaining eras and the Classics scenario cards. These come after the first batch.

prompts.title: Style keyframe: the stare-down
prompts.builds: The master look: lighting, colour grade, fog and sky for every scene.
prompts.tip: Generate three or four variations and keep the one you love. Attach it to every prompt after this one.
prompts.prompt: Cinematic wide frame of a penalty kick at night in a dreamlike arena. In the foreground a kicker in a deep teal kit stands behind the ball on the penalty spot, seen from behind and slightly to one side. On the goal line the keeper, in a warm amber kit, crouches with his eyes locked on the kicker. The white goal frame glows faintly. Around them the stadium rises into towering tiers of softly glowing crowd silhouettes that blur upward into an indigo sky full of green and violet aurora. A thin ribbon of gold light curls from the ball toward the top corner of the goal, as if showing the shot the kicker is imagining. Low mist drifts across grass painted with rich mowing stripes. The mood is a held breath just before the strike.

prompts.title: Palette and materials board
prompts.builds: The Blender material library and the colour values every scene shares.
prompts.prompt: A tidy art-direction board on a dark indigo background, using the colours of the attached keyframe. Across the top, a row of eight plain colour swatches: night indigo, violet, teal, aurora green, warm gold, amber, chalk white and deep pitch green. Below them, six glossy material spheres in a row showing how surfaces should look: painterly striped grass, stitched ball leather, smooth modern ball synthetic, the soft glow of the crowd, goal-net mesh with a faint glow on its knots, and kit fabric with a subtle woven texture.

prompts.title: Light language: four ball flights
prompts.builds: The ball-trail effects. In Blender the ribbons follow real flight paths exported from the game's own physics.
prompts.prompt: Four panels side by side, each showing a football's flight as a ribbon of light against a dark painterly sky, seen from the side. Panel one: a smooth bending curve for a curling shot, in gold. Panel two: an arc that dips sharply at the end for a topspin shot, in violet. Panel three: a nearly straight path that wobbles and shimmers only in its last third, for a knuckleball, in cyan. Panel four: a high, gentle lob for a chip, in soft white. In every panel the ribbon is brightest at the ball and fades into sparkling dust behind it.

prompts.title: Kicker turnaround
prompts.builds: The kicker model, rigged as a humanoid so animations can be shared and exported to Unity.
prompts.tip: If ChatGPT adds perspective or shadows, reply: “flatter, orthographic, no shadows, same height in every view”.
prompts.prompt: Character turnaround model sheet of the kicker from the attached keyframe: an original young footballer with an athletic, slightly elongated stylized build, short curly dark hair, warm brown skin and determined eyes. Deep teal kit with a subtle gold wave pattern across the shirt, white shorts, teal socks and gold boots. Three full-body views side by side: front, left side and back. A-pose, with arms angled 45 degrees down and feet shoulder-width apart.

prompts.title: Kicker face and expressions
prompts.builds: Head modelling and the facial shape keys for stare-down close-ups.
prompts.prompt: Head and face reference sheet for the kicker in the attached turnaround. Top row: the neutral head from the front, three-quarter and side. Bottom row: four expressions from the front: calm focus, a sly bluffing half-smile, wide-eyed joy after scoring, and frustration after a miss. Shoulders up, with the same face shape and hair in every view.

prompts.title: Keeper turnaround
prompts.builds: The keeper model, on the same humanoid rig as the kicker.
prompts.tip: Start a new ChatGPT chat for the keeper so the kicker's features don't bleed into him.
prompts.prompt: Character turnaround model sheet of the keeper from the attached keyframe: an original goalkeeper, tall with long arms and large hands, stylized proportions, shaved head with a short beard, light tan skin and calm, intense eyes. Long-sleeved warm amber goalkeeper kit with darker amber elbow pads and a faint geometric pattern, black shorts, amber socks, and chunky gloves whose fingertips glow softly. Three full-body views side by side: front, left side and back. A-pose, with arms angled 45 degrees down and feet shoulder-width apart.

prompts.title: Keeper face and gloves
prompts.builds: The keeper's head, facial shape keys and glove model.
prompts.prompt: Face and glove reference sheet for the keeper in the attached turnaround. Top row: the neutral head from the front, three-quarter and side. Bottom row: four expressions from the front: reading the kicker with narrowed eyes, a taunting grin, a roaring celebration, and quiet despair. On the right, a close study of one goalkeeper glove from the palm side and from the back.

prompts.title: Wall players
prompts.builds: Three body types for the defensive wall in free kicks.
prompts.prompt: Turnaround sheet of three original outfield players who will form a defensive wall, all in the same deep crimson kit with a faint diagonal pattern: one broad and short, one tall and lean, one of medium build, each with a different hairstyle and skin tone. Show each player from the front and from the left side, standing in an A-pose, so there are six full-body views in one row.

prompts.title: Kit flat-lays
prompts.builds: Texture painting for the kits and the alternate colours.
prompts.prompt: Flat-lay kit design sheet seen straight down: four complete football kits, each laid out neatly with shirt, shorts and socks and shown from the front and the back. The kicker's teal and gold kit from the attached turnaround, an alternate kit in chalk white and violet, the keeper's amber kit from the attached turnaround, and the wall team's deep crimson kit. Fabric weave and pattern detail clearly visible.

prompts.title: The referee
prompts.builds: The referee who sprays the 9.15 m line and pushes the wall back.
prompts.prompt: Character turnaround model sheet of an original referee with a calm, theatrical presence, like a conductor: night-black kit with luminous gold piping, a whistle on a cord, and a can of vanishing spray in one hand. Three full-body views side by side: front, left side and back, in an A-pose.

prompts.title: Run-up and side-foot strike
prompts.builds: The 1.5-second run-up and the placed shot.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the kicker in the attached turnaround taking a penalty, seen from the side. Eight poses in a single row from left to right, evenly spaced: standing ready behind the ball; first step; mid-stride; long last stride with the planted foot landing beside the ball; kicking leg swinging back; side-foot contact with the ball; follow-through; landing and looking up.

prompts.title: Driven knuckleball strike
prompts.builds: The laces strike that feeds the knuckleball.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the kicker in the attached turnaround striking a driven knuckleball, seen from the side. Eight poses in a single row from left to right, evenly spaced: ready; fast approach; planted foot; kicking leg cocked high; laces striking through the middle of the ball with the ankle locked; short, stabbing follow-through; landing; watching the ball fly.

prompts.title: Curler and trivela
prompts.builds: The inside-of-the-foot curler and the outside-of-the-foot trivela.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the kicker in the attached turnaround, seen from the side, in two rows. Top row, four poses of an inside-of-the-foot curler, with the body wrapping around the ball. Bottom row, four poses of an outside-of-the-foot trivela, with the kicking leg swinging across the body.

prompts.title: The chip
prompts.builds: The soft chip that punishes an early dive.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the kicker in the attached turnaround playing a soft chip down the middle, seen from the side. Six poses in a single row from left to right: ready; approach, slowing; planted foot; kicking leg swinging gently; foot scooping under the ball; a cheeky follow-through with the weight leaning back.

prompts.title: Stutter run-up
prompts.builds: The stutter bluff.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the kicker in the attached turnaround doing a stutter run-up, seen from the side. Six poses in a single row from left to right: approach; a sudden hop and pause mid-run with the arms out for balance; a second small hop; the long final stride; the strike; follow-through.

prompts.title: Keeper ready and shuffle
prompts.builds: The keeper's idle stance and the shuffle bluff on the line.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the keeper in the attached turnaround, seen from the front. Six poses in a single row from left to right: crouched ready stance on the goal line; shuffle step to his left; shuffle step to his right; arms spread wide to look big; bouncing on his toes; set position a moment before the dive.

prompts.title: Keeper dives: low, middle, top corner
prompts.builds: The dives, mirrored in Blender for the other side. Early and late dives are the same poses with different timing.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the keeper in the attached turnaround, seen from the front as the kicker sees him, in three rows of four poses, all diving to the same side. Top row, a low dive to the bottom corner. Middle row, a dive at waist height. Bottom row, a full-stretch leap to the top corner. Each row runs from left to right: push-off, take-off, full stretch at the height of the ball, landing.

prompts.title: Stay big, catch and parry
prompts.builds: Staying big, catches and parries.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the keeper in the attached turnaround, seen from the front. Six poses in a single row from left to right: staying big in a star shape with arms and legs spread; catching a ball against his chest; smothering a low ball on the ground; a one-handed fingertip tip over the bar; a two-fisted punch; getting back up from the ground.

prompts.title: The wall
prompts.builds: Wall set-up, jump, brace and the lying man for Wall Wars and the Classics cards.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet of the wall players in the attached sheet, seen from the side. Eight poses in a single row from left to right: lining up shoulder to shoulder; hands covering in the set position; crouching before the jump; jumping together with arms down; landing; one player staying grounded to block a low shot; one player lying flat on the ground behind the wall; turning to watch the ball.

prompts.title: Celebrations and dejection
prompts.builds: The after-kick reactions for both players.
prompts.prompt: Animation key-pose sheet in two rows. Top row, the kicker in the first attached turnaround, four poses: a knee slide, an arms-wide aeroplane run, a finger to the lips, and hands on head after a miss. Bottom row, the keeper in the second attached turnaround, four poses: a roaring fist pump, pointing to the crowd, lying face down after conceding, and standing with hands on hips.

prompts.title: Three era balls
prompts.builds: The three balls, each paired with its era's physics in the game.
prompts.prompt: Orthographic reference of three original footballs in one row, each shown from the front and from the side. A 1970s ball of hand-stitched brown leather in the classic 32-panel pattern of hexagons and pentagons, slightly worn and scuffed. A 1990s glossy white ball with bold original curved-triangle graphics in black and gold. A modern lightweight ball with smooth bonded panels and an original iridescent teal and violet swirl pattern.

prompts.title: Goal frame and net
prompts.builds: The goal to real dimensions, with a net that ripples and glows on a goal.
prompts.prompt: Orthographic reference of a full-size football goal in the attached style, front view and side view next to each other: slim, rounded white posts and crossbar, a deep net held out by thin back supports, and net mesh that glows faintly where light catches the knots. Add a close-up inset of the net knots in the corner.

prompts.title: Penalty area details
prompts.builds: Line markings, the penalty spot, the spray line and the corner flag.
prompts.prompt: Overhead view of the penalty area of a football pitch in the attached style: crisp painted white lines, the penalty spot, a curved line of white vanishing spray on the grass, and, beside the frame, a tall corner flag shown from the side.

prompts.title: Floodlights through the eras
prompts.builds: One floodlight design per era.
prompts.prompt: Three original floodlight designs side by side, all seen from the front: a 1970s lattice steel tower topped with round lamps, a 1990s angular chrome tower with rectangular lamp banks, and a modern slender arch that is itself a line of light.

prompts.title: The dream arena from above
prompts.builds: The layout and scale of the first playable arena.
prompts.prompt: Aerial three-quarter view of the dream arena from the attached keyframe at night. The pitch floats on a still, dark lake that mirrors the sky, ringed by towering, gently impossible curved stands whose crowd glows like a sea of tiny warm lights. Slender arches of light stand where floodlights would be. The aurora above washes everything in green and violet. One end of the pitch, with its goal, is in the foreground.

prompts.title: Game camera: behind the ball
prompts.builds: The main kicker camera, framed for a phone.
prompts.prompt: The game camera's view from just behind and above the ball on the penalty spot, looking at the goal in the attached arena. The keeper is set on his line, and the glowing stands rise behind the goal into the aurora sky. Framed for a phone held upright: the goal fills the upper half, and the ball sits in the lower third with clear space around it.

prompts.title: Game camera: keeper's view
prompts.builds: The keeper camera, framed for a phone.
prompts.prompt: The keeper's view from just in front of the goal line at eye height, looking out at the kicker from the attached keyframe standing behind the ball 11 metres away. The glowing crowd and the aurora sky fill the background. Framed for a phone held upright, with the kicker small and central and the goal posts just out of frame on either side.

prompts.title: Stands and crowd up close
prompts.builds: Stand geometry and the crowd shader.
prompts.prompt: A close view of one tier of the arena stands in the attached style: the crowd painted as soft silhouettes holding glowing scarves, with tiny sparkles of light scattered through them and a wave of light rippling across the tier. Painterly blur toward the top of the frame.

prompts.title: The stare-down
prompts.builds: The stare-down cinematic camera and face lighting.
prompts.prompt: A split composition at the moment before a penalty: the left half is an extreme close-up of the kicker's eyes and brow from the first attached sheet, the right half the keeper's eyes from the second attached sheet. Both are rim-lit in gold, and the background melts into aurora colours. The tension of two friends trying to read each other.

prompts.title: The goal
prompts.builds: The net burst, crowd wave and camera for a goal.
prompts.prompt: The instant a penalty hits the back of the net in the attached arena: the net bulges and bursts into a shower of gold light particles, the keeper lies on the grass where he dived, and a wave of light sweeps through the crowd behind the goal.

prompts.title: The fingertip save
prompts.builds: The slow-motion save with afterimages.
prompts.prompt: A frozen slow-motion moment of the keeper from the attached turnaround at full stretch, tipping the ball around the post with his fingertips. Faint afterimages trail behind his body, and droplets and particles of light hang suspended in the air.

prompts.title: The slow-motion replay
prompts.builds: The replay camera and trail styling.
prompts.prompt: A side-on slow-motion replay frame: the full flight of a knuckleball drawn as a cyan ribbon of light that wobbles near the goal, the ball frozen in mid-air above a jumping wall of crimson players, and the keeper beginning his dive.

prompts.title: Painterly grass
prompts.builds: The pitch surface.
prompts.prompt: Hand-painted stylized grass, rich deep green with soft brush strokes and slight colour variation, with alternating wide light and dark mowing stripes running vertically.

prompts.title: Worn goalmouth
prompts.builds: The scuffed turf in front of the goal.
prompts.prompt: Worn goalmouth turf in the same painted style as the attached grass: patchy grass with scuffed bare-earth patches and stud marks.

prompts.title: Crowd sprites
prompts.builds: Billboard sprites for thousands of fans, cut out on the green background.
prompts.tip: The pure green background is what lets me cut the fans out. If ChatGPT adds a floor or shadows, ask again for flat #00FF00.
prompts.prompt: A sheet of sixteen different stylized fans in a four-by-four grid, each a full-body painterly figure in a different pose: cheering with arms up, clapping, holding a scarf over the head, hands on head, jumping. Every figure is on a flat, pure green background (#00FF00) with clear space between figures. This overrides the grey background for this sheet.

prompts.title: Night sky dome
prompts.builds: The 360-degree sky around the arena.
prompts.prompt: A wide panoramic night sky for a 360-degree sky dome: deep indigo with sweeping green and violet aurora curtains, scattered stars and soft painterly clouds near the horizon. The horizon runs exactly across the middle of the image, with no ground, buildings or people.

prompts.title: 1970s world: the sun-bleached afternoon
prompts.builds: The 1970s era, paired with the heavy leather ball.
prompts.prompt: The same penalty end reimagined as a 1970s afternoon memory: concrete terraces packed with swaying fans in muted coats, a hazy amber sun low behind the stand, chalky pastel colours, a lattice floodlight tower, faint film grain and soft light leaks at the edges, a brown leather ball on the spot, and a worn, muddy goalmouth.

prompts.title: 1990s world: floodlight neon
prompts.builds: The 1990s era, paired with the glossy, big-bending ball.
prompts.prompt: The same penalty end reimagined as a 1990s night under blazing floodlights: chrome and concrete stands, magenta and teal light flares, a glossy white ball on the spot, wet grass mirroring the lights, and a faint scanline shimmer in the air.

prompts.title: Classic: The Impossible Banana
prompts.builds: The 35 m free kick that has to start wide of the post.
prompts.prompt: A free kick 35 metres from goal on a clifftop pitch at golden hour, with the sea far below. A wall of crimson players stands at the spray line, and a ribbon of gold light starts far wide of the post before bending back toward the far corner.

prompts.title: Classic: Ninety-Third Minute
prompts.builds: One kick, a wall of six, everything on it.
prompts.prompt: A storm at night: a wall of six crimson players braced at the spray line, rain lashing sideways through beams of light, lightning over the stand, and the kicker alone behind the ball.

prompts.title: Classic: The Ice-Cold Chip
prompts.builds: The keeper who always dives early.
prompts.prompt: A frozen lake arena under a pale blue dawn, breath clouding in the cold air. The keeper has dived early into the snow while a soft chip floats over him, trailing a ribbon of white light.

prompts.title: Classic: Monsoon Final
prompts.builds: The wet, skidding ball.
prompts.prompt: Torrential warm rain at dusk with glowing raindrops, puddles mirroring neon light, and the ball skidding across the soaked grass, throwing up a spray of water.

prompts.title: Classic: Above the Clouds
prompts.builds: The high-altitude stadium where the ball flies further.
prompts.prompt: A pitch on a mountain plateau high above the clouds: thin, bright air, sharp sunlight, clouds drifting below the edges of the stands, and the kicker's shadow stretched long across the grass.
